g.text: Projection paths have explicit higher comparisons
One common section I P_a I = 1 δH_a = 1 − I P_a
T_ij = P_j H_i
δT_ij = P_j − P_i
T_012 = −P₂ H₁ H₀
T_a₀…aᵣ = (−1)^{r(r−1)/2} P_aᵣ H_aᵣ₋₁ ⋯ H_a₀
Every higher face is its alternating omitted-index sum.
Contract precisely the restriction kernel
r : Hom(Z,Y) → End(Y) r(φ) = φ I
δK + Kδ = 1 on ker r K² = 0
End(Y) remains a retract; it is not declared acyclic.
An essential second comparison with even cohomology
Y = k z⁻² f⁻² → g⁻¹ u⁻¹ → v⁰
du = v: its Hom differential supplies the same 2z.
Omitting the second comparison breaks the triangle face.
Original native parameters remain inside every coefficient map.
All degrees and face signs: Theorem 29. Exact five-vector model: Exercise 29.
Free module background: Keller, arXiv:math/9910179, §4.2.
These auxiliary comparison labels do not merge distinct original native arrows.
